text: A shot that runs too fast tastes thin and sour because the water has not had contact time to dissolve the sugars. Grind finer before you touch the dose.
Channeling happens when water finds a low resistance path through the puck. Distribute the grounds evenly and tamp level rather than hard.
Keep the basket weight constant while you change one variable at a time, otherwise you cannot tell which change moved the taste.
If the chain slips under load on the rear cassette, the culprit is usually a stretched chain that has worn the teeth into a hooked shape.
Measure chain wear with a gauge every few hundred miles. Replacing a chain early is far cheaper than replacing the cassette and chainrings with it.
Index the rear derailleur by setting the limit screws first, then adjusting cable tension one click at a time until shifts are crisp in both directions.
A starter that doubles in four hours at room temperature and smells faintly of yogurt is ready to leaven bread.
Dense crumb with a pale crust almost always means the dough was underproofed, not that the oven was too cool.
Retarding shaped loaves overnight in the refrigerator develops flavour and makes the cold dough much easier to score cleanly.
Yellow lower leaves on a monstera are the classic sign of overwatering. Let the top few inches of soil dry before watering again.
New leaves emerge without splits when light is too low. Move the plant closer to a bright window rather than adding fertilizer.
Bright light in the first hour after waking anchors the circadian clock and does more for morning alertness than an extra half hour in bed.
Caffeine has a half life of about five hours, so an afternoon cup is still measurably present in the blood at bedtime.
A cool dark room helps because core body temperature must fall for sleep to begin and stay consolidated through the night.
Most of the weekly volume should be slow enough to hold a conversation. Hard days are only useful if the easy days are genuinely easy.
Hitting the wall late in a race is glycogen depletion. Practise taking carbohydrate during long runs so the gut is trained for it.
Taper by cutting volume while keeping some intensity in the final two weeks so the legs stay sharp without accumulating fatigue.
Keep receipts for anything you intend to deduct as a business expense. A bank statement alone rarely satisfies an auditor asking what a charge was for.
Quarterly estimated payments avoid an underpayment penalty when income arrives irregularly through the year rather than as a steady salary.
Buzzing on the lower frets usually means the neck relief is too flat. Loosen the truss rod a quarter turn and let it settle overnight.
Intonation is set at the saddles by comparing the fretted twelfth fret note against the harmonic and lengthening the string until they agree.
Wipe the strings after playing. Most of what dulls a set is skin oil and sweat rather than the playing itself.
Wrap many inserts in a single transaction. Committing per row forces a durable write each time and is the usual reason a bulk load crawls.
Write ahead logging lets readers proceed while a writer is active, which removes most of the contention a busy single file database suffers.
An index that does not cover the columns in the where clause will be ignored by the planner. Read the query plan before adding another one.
The borrow checker rejects two mutable references to the same value at once. Restructure so ownership moves rather than reaching for a clone.
Reference counted pointers with interior mutability are the escape hatch for shared state, and they move the check from compile time to run time.
A hive that has lost its queen becomes noticeably louder and irritable within a day, and you will find no eggs in the brood frames.
Leave enough honey stores through winter. Feeding sugar syrup late is a rescue measure and never as good as the colony's own reserves.
Salting the cabbage draws out water so the leaves stay crisp through fermentation instead of turning limp in the jar.
Keep everything below the brine. Anything exposed to air is where mould starts, and a weight solves it more reliably than stirring.
